about: RMA-SEED (feat/pine-dmi-rma-seed, NUMBER PENDING): ta.rma's seed is the exactly rounded sum / n (one rule, rmaSeedMean, read by CARRIED.rma on both lanes, rsiPineStep and FN_PINE.rsi; Python twin _rma_seed_mean), and ta.dmi is TradingView's body over ta.rma (PINE_TUPLE_BUILTINS.dmi, unequal periods served). Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.

mutants.mutant: ta.rma's seed is the left-to-right running sum again (the kernel table, both lanes)
mutants.from: const rmaStep = smoothStepOf((prev, v, n) => (prev * (n - 1) + v) / n, true)
mutants.to: const rmaStep = smoothStepOf((prev, v, n) => (prev * (n - 1) + v) / n, false)

mutants.mutant: the one seed rule sums left to right
mutants.from: export const rmaSeedMean = (values, lo, n) => exactSum(values, lo, lo + n - 1) / n
mutants.to: export const rmaSeedMean = (values, lo, n) => { let s = 0; for (let k = lo; k < lo + n; k += 1) s += values[k]; return s / n }
mutants.expectRed: exactly rounded sum over its length

mutants.mutant: the runtime lane's ta.rsi kernel seeds its gain average left to right
mutants.from: st[o + 4] = rmaSeedMean(st, o + RSI_PINE_CELLS, n); st[o + 5] = rmaSeedMean(st, o + RSI_PINE_CELLS + cap, n)
mutants.to: st[o + 4] = Array.from(st.subarray(o + RSI_PINE_CELLS, o + RSI_PINE_CELLS + n)).reduce((s, x) => s + x, 0) / n; st[o + 5] = rmaSeedMean(st, o + RSI_PINE_CELLS + cap, n)

mutants.mutant: the host lane's Pine ta.rsi drops the seed rule (reads the native RSI's running sum)
mutants.from: rsi: (s, n) => bindShipped(['c'], [s], s.length, (bars) => computeRSI(bars, n, PINE_RSI)),
mutants.to: rsi: (s, n) => bindShipped(['c'], [s], s.length, (bars) => computeRSI(bars, n)),

mutants.mutant: computeRSI ignores the seed it is handed for the gain average
mutants.from: avgGain = seedMean ? seedMean(gains, 0, period) : sumGain / period
mutants.to: avgGain = seedMean ? gains.reduce((s, x) => s + x, 0) / period : sumGain / period

mutants.mutant: the column driver sizes a growing store as three scalars (the seed values are lost)
mutants.from: const st = new Float64Array(carriedCellsOf(spec, n, series.length))
mutants.to: const st = new Float64Array(typeof spec.cells === 'function' ? 3 : spec.cells)

mutants.mutant: ta.dmi's ADX smooths over the FIRST length (unequal pairs wrong)
mutants.from: bin('/', pc('math.abs', [bin('-', plus, minus)]), tern(bin('==', sum, num(0)), num(1), sum)), a[1]]))
mutants.to: bin('/', pc('math.abs', [bin('-', plus, minus)]), tern(bin('==', sum, num(0)), num(1), sum)), a[0]]))
